description: Replace an order's line items (full replace of the items array). Recomputes subtotal, discount, tax, shipping and total, keeping the discount, tax treatment and price lists frozen at checkout. Stock follows the change in quantities. amountPaid does not change, so balanceDue and the payment status follow the new total; no money moves. Refused for a canceled order, once the order has a parcel that is not canceled, and unless the payment status is unpaid, partially_paid or paid (so after any refund). For notes, email, PO number or address, update_order_details. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.

items.description: The order's complete new line list - every line to keep, not only the changed ones; a line left out is removed

price.description: Custom unit price in minor units of the order's currency (ad-hoc item)

recordId.description: Product record id the line refers to
